title: Moving Valid Window
summary: Maintain information about one contiguous active range while its boundaries move.
recognition_signals: one boundary adds new state while the other removes or expires it
the validity of a range can be repaired incrementally
core_rules: After repair, the active range satisfies the stated validity condition.
structural_steps: repair by moving the left boundary

common_confusions.distinction: A moving window maintains one active range as its boundaries change. Prefix state precomputes cumulative information for fixed-range queries.
